tree.heading: Administrator
tree.text: The term “Administrator” means the Administrator of the Energy Information Administration.

tree.heading: Annual Critical Minerals Outlook
tree.text: The term “Annual Critical Minerals Outlook” means the Annual Critical Minerals Outlook prepared under section 1606(j)(1)(B) of title 30.

tree.heading: Critical mineral
tree.text: The term “critical mineral” has the meaning given the term in section 1606(a) of title 30.

tree.heading: Household energy burden
tree.text: The term “household energy burden” means the quotient obtained by dividing—

children.text: the residential energy expenditures (as defined in section 440.3 of title 10, Code of Federal Regulations (as in effect on November 15, 2021)) of the applicable household; by
the annual income of that household.

tree.heading: Household with a high energy burden
tree.text: The term “household with a high energy burden” has the meaning given the term in section 440.3 of title 10, Code of Federal Regulations (as in effect on November 15, 2021).

tree.heading: Large manufacturing facility
tree.text: The term “large manufacturing facility” means a manufacturing facility that—

children.text: annually consumes more than 35,000 megawatt-hours of electricity; or
has a peak power demand of more than 10 megawatts.

tree.heading: Load-serving entity
tree.text: The term “load-serving entity” has the meaning given the term in section 824q(a) of title 16.

tree.heading: Miscellaneous electric load
tree.text: The term “miscellaneous electric load” means electricity that—

children.text: is used by an appliance or device—
is not used for heating, ventilation, air conditioning, lighting, water heating, or refrigeration.

tree.heading: Regional Transmission Organization
tree.text: The term “Regional Transmission Organization” has the meaning given the term in section 796 of title 16.

tree.heading: Rural area
tree.text: The term “rural area” has the meaning given the term in section 918c(a) of title 7.

notes.heading: Wage Rate Requirements
notes.text: For provisions relating to rates of wages to be paid to laborers and mechanics on projects for construction, alteration, or repair work funded under div. D or an amendment by div. D of Pub. L. 117–58, including authority of Secretary of Labor, see section 18851 of this title.
